release_notes: Camera supplied in the official QuarkView 6108BW 5MP wireless camera system (kit 6108BW-4-63-AI-50W-CP, Shenzhen Kuake Trading Co., Ltd.). The page shows no separate camera model code; 63-AI-50W is taken from the kit SKU (the 3MP sibling kit XM-6108BW-4-63-AI-30W pairs with the XM-63-AI-30W camera). The page states 5MP, H.265, a metal IP66 housing, a wireless camera link to the 6108BW recorder, a power adapter per camera, human detection, two-way audio and colour night viewing; bullet type is from the official product image (Wi-Fi bullet with antenna). Lens, field of view, IR/illuminator details, frame rate, app, RTSP/ONVIF and dimensions are not published.
